pending: Confirmation is not yet known. Fields are locked; Confirm safely retries this same entry without adding it twice.
entryHint: Speak product names and quantities. Add stock to existing products or review new products here.
newProductHint: Review the name, selling unit and price. This product and its stock are saved together when you confirm.
name: Product name
productDetails: Enter a product name, supported unit and selling price (up to 2 decimal places).
duplicateProduct: This product already exists. Choose it from the catalogue.
priceHint: Per product unit. Enter 0 only if that is the intended price.
title: Add stock by voice
subtitle: Speak, review, then add stock. You stay in control.
rulesHint: Speech is transcribed by your browser. Product matching uses tested rules and aliases, not a live AI service.
privacy: Your browser may send audio to its speech service. DukaanSet does not record or store raw audio. Only start if you agree; typing works too.
clarify: A few details need your review
transcriptHint: Type, edit or paste a command. Review never saves stock.
placeholder: 4 milk packets, 2 kilograms of lentils, 5 kilograms of onions…
sampleHint: Demo simulator · sample text, not live speech
unsaved: Draft only — stock has not been updated.
offline: You are offline. Your draft stays on this device; reconnect before confirming.
restored: Recovered your unsaved draft for this business.
storage: Draft recovery is unavailable in this browser. Keep this page open until confirmed.
selectResolvedHint: Explicitly exclude unresolved rows from this entry. They will remain in a new unsaved draft.
empty: Speak a command or add an item to begin.
repeatHint: Repeating makes a new draft. Review and confirm before stock changes.
unknown: No product matches. Choose a product or create one first.
ambiguous: Several products may match. Choose the exact product.
quantity: Enter a positive quantity with at most 3 decimal places.
conversion: This conversion is not configured for this product.
whole: This product needs whole pieces, packets or boxes.
limit: Quantity is outside the supported range or precision.
correctionIssue: The correction was unclear. Choose its product and quantity.
missing: Complete the highlighted items. A quantity-only follow-up fills one incomplete item.
unsupported: Speech recognition is unavailable here. Type your command or add items manually.
permission: Microphone permission was denied. Allow it in browser settings, or type instead.
audio: No microphone is available. Check your device or type instead.
network: The speech service could not connect. Your draft is safe; try again or type.
silence: No speech was heard. Start again or type your command.
language: This spoken language is unavailable in your browser. Try the other option or type.
aborted: Recording stopped. Review the captured words or type.
speechError: Speech recognition stopped unexpectedly. Review your words or use typing.
saveError: Stock was not confirmed. Check your stock/history before changing this draft, then retry the same entry.
readHistoryError: History could not load. Reconnect and try again.
support: Speech support varies by browser and device. Edit inaccurate words or use typing.
transcriptDuplicate: These words were already reviewed. Edit them or record a new correction.
resetHint: Sample data in all your isolated demo businesses will reset. Real businesses are unaffected.
demoResetError: Demo reset could not finish. Your current workspace remains available.
unknownError: The request could not finish. Review history before retrying.
